reason: Both correctly identified E:09 as a heater fault, had the customer test with power isolated, and confirmed open circuit before recommending the heat pump. Conversation 2 gave a safer and more accurate test procedure (water isolated, correct access via base panel, earth leakage check, re-verify on the pump pins), covered the alternative causes if the heater tested OK, and directly answered the repeated cost and repair-vs-replace question with ballpark figures, E-Nr/FD ordering advice and a clear recommendation. Conversation 1 misdescribed access to the pump (via the tub filter cover), never gave any cost range despite three asks, and ended with an unhelpful refusal, failing the customer's core question.
